import polars as pl
from io import BytesIO

# Create a sample DataFrame
df_original = pl.DataFrame({
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie"],
    "age": [25, 30, 35],
    "score": [95.5, 87.3, 92.1],
})

print("Original DataFrame:")
print(df_original)
print()

# Serialize to Parquet in memory
buffer = BytesIO()
df_original.write_parquet(buffer)

# Get the binary data
parquet_bytes = buffer.getvalue()
print(f"Serialized Parquet size: {len(parquet_bytes)} bytes")
print()

# Deserialize from the binary buffer
buffer.seek(0)
df_restored = pl.read_parquet(buffer)

print("Restored DataFrame:")
print(df_restored)
print()

# Verify round trip
print("Round trip successful:", df_original.frame_equal(df_restored))
